mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.CATEGORY = #{category}
AND (B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CATEGORY, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS nickName, -- ★ 점수 계산 (B.LIKE_COUNT * 3 + B.COMMENT_COUNT * 2 + B.VIEW_COUNT * 0.5) AS hotScore, (SELECT BI.IMG_URL FROM BOARD_IMG BI WHERE BI.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID ORDER BY BI.SORT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumbUrl FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN USER U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) -- ★ 오늘 기준 ORDER BY hotScore DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.USER_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.CATEGORY, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.DISLIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.IS_HOT, B.HAS_POLL, B.PRODUCT_ID, B.STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(B.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS nickName, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS productPrice, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS productImg FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN USER U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON B.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE B.BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (USER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, HAS_POLL, PRODUCT_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{hasPoll}, NULLIF(#{productId}, ''), 'ACTIVE', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CATEGORY = #{category}, PRODUCT_ID = NULLIF(#{productId}, ''), UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE BOARD SET STATUS = 'DELETED' WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE BOARD SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET IS_HOT = CASE WHEN LIKE_COUNT >= 20 AND CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE BOARD SET COMMENT_COUNT = COMMENT_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET COMMENT_COUNT = GREATEST(COMMENT_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_IMG (BOARD_ID, IMG_URL, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{imgUrl}, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT IMG_ID AS imgId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM BOARD_IMG WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.BOARD_ID, C.USER_ID, C.PARENT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.LIKE_COUNT, C.STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS nickName, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg FROM BOARD_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN USER U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND C.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY COALESCE(C.PARENT_ID, C.COMMENT_ID) ASC, C.COMMENT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT (BOARD_ID, USER_ID, PARENT_ID, CONTENT, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userId}, NULLIF(#{parentId}, ''), #{content}, 'ACTIVE', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT SET STATUS = 'DELETED' WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_REACTION (BOARD_ID, COMMENT_ID, USER_ID, TYPE, TARGET, CREATED_AT) VALUES (NULLIF(#{boardId},''), NULLIF(#{commentId},''), #{userId}, #{type}, #{target}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET LIKE_COUNT = GREATEST(LIKE_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET DISLIKE_COUNT = DISLIKE_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET DISLIKE_COUNT = GREATEST(DISLIKE_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT SET LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT + 1 WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT SET LIKE_COUNT = GREATEST(LIKE_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_REPORT (BOARD_ID, COMMENT_ID, USER_ID, REASON, TARGET, CREATED_AT) VALUES (NULLIF(#{boardId},''), NULLIF(#{commentId},''), #{userId}, #{reason}, #{target}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET STATUS = 'BLIND' WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND TARGET = 'BOARD') >= 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POLL (BOARD_ID, QUESTION, END_DATE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{question}, NULLIF(#{endDate}, ''), NOW())
INSERT INTO BOARD_POLL_OPTION (POLL_ID, OPTION_TEXT, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{optionText}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT P.POLL_ID, P.QUESTION, DATE_FORMAT(P.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DATE, (SELECT SUM(VOTE_COUNT) FROM BOARD_POLL_OPTION WHERE POLL_ID = P.POLL_ID) AS totalVotes FROM BOARD_POLL P WHERE P.BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
SELECT OPTION_ID AS optionId, OPTION_TEXT AS optionText, VOTE_COUNT AS voteCount, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM BOARD_POLL_OPTION WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POLL_VOTE WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT OPTION_ID AS optionId FROM BOARD_POLL_VOTE WHERE POLL_ID = #{pollId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POLL_VOTE (POLL_ID, OPTION_ID, USER_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{optionId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO BOARD_BOOKMARK (USER_ID, BOARD_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boardId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.BOARD_ID, b.TITLE, b.CONTENT, b.CATEGORY, b.USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(b.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT, b.VIEW_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(bb.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS BOOKMARKED_AT FROM BOARD_BOOKMARK bb JOIN BOARD b ON bb.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID WHERE bb.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY bb.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_TAG ( BOARD_ID, TAG_NAME, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{tagName}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT TAG_NAME FROM BOARD_TAG WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY TAG_ID ASC

SELECT b.BOARD_ID, b.TITLE, b.CONTENT, b.CATEGORY, b.USER_ID, b.LIKE_COUNT, b.DISLIKE_COUNT, b.COMMENT_COUNT, b.VIEW_COUNT, b.IS_HOT, b.HAS_POLL, DATE_FORMAT(b.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD b JOIN BOARD_TAG t ON b.BOARD_ID = t.BOARD_ID WHERE t.TAG_NAME = #{tag} AND b.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY b.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, LIKE_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT, VIEW_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
